description: This file defines a 'Token' class used in a mathematical expression evaluator to represent different kinds of tokens such as operators, literals, functions, and brackets, along with static factory methods for creating tokens of each type.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a token in an expression, such as an operator, literal, function, or bracket, with methods to handle token properties and categorization.

methods.name: buildLiteral
methods.description: Creates a literal token from a string literal.

methods.name: buildOperator
methods.description: Creates an operator token from an Operator object.

methods.name: buildFunction
methods.description: Creates a function token from a Function object.

methods.name: buildOpenToken
methods.description: Creates an open bracket token from a BracketPair object.

methods.name: buildCloseToken
methods.description: Creates a close bracket token from a BracketPair object.
